_meta.keys_note: Per src/overworld/overworld.js + region78/arena.js: battle_lost = trainer lost (player WON), battle_won = trainer won (player lost); after = later talks once beaten. TEXT_SPOTS asks for 'intro'; the talk code reads the challenge from 'pages', so Coder maps intro -> pages when merging into overworld_lines.json maps.<map>.<id>.
_meta.not_reused: v1 tech_watch (Head Observer Calder) has no slot; tech_15 and chief written fresh as asked.

fin_wlab_tech_1.name: Intake Clerk Mavis
intro:
Lanyard, please. No pass, no entry.
The stock logs must stay clean.
battle_won:
Back to the lobby with you.
The white line is there for a reason.
battle_lost:
Fine. Sign in. Batch 9 is
through the left door. Don't look.
after:
I'm signing the log 'all quiet.'
That's the last lie I'll write.

fin_wlab_tech_2.name: Medic Tech Ilsa
intro:
Retention fell to 40 percent.
I can't lose more of the batch.
battle_won:
Lie down. I'll log your bruises
as 'handling incident.' Again.
battle_lost:
Every scar here has a file number.
I wrote most of them myself.
after:
The hum's gone quiet in my head.
First time in months.

fin_wlab_tech_3.name: Control Tech Wenna
intro:
Panel says yield is up three
points. So why are they crying?
battle_won:
Output's steady. Good. Good.
Nothing to report upstairs.
battle_lost:
Shut it all down, then. I'll
say the lights failed. Go.
after:
Test 8 is off the board.
Finch was right all along.

fin_wlab_tech_4.name: Override Tech Stellan
intro:
The Guardian feeds the lines.
No spark, no lab. No lab, no us.
battle_won:
The lines stay lit. You see?
The research needs him whole.
battle_lost:
Ondravel never asked to be
a battery. I know. I know.
after:
If he goes dark, so do we.
Maybe that's fair.

fin_wlab_tech_5.name: Tank Tech Dorrit
intro:
Tank 12 is near term. If you
break the seal, we lose the run.
battle_won:
Seal's intact. The run lives.
I'll breathe again tomorrow.
battle_lost:
Go on. Let them see the sky.
They were never ours to keep.
after:
Tank 12's lid is up.
It looked at me. Then left.

fin_wlab_tech_6.name: Doorman Tech Orrin
intro:
Nobody walks out with lab stock.
Not tonight. Not ever.
battle_won:
Nobody leaves. Not stock,
not strangers. Not tonight.
battle_lost:
They sang at the glass last week.
I told myself it was the pumps.
after:
I left the door open.
The stock knows the way out.

fin_wlab_tech_7.name: Tagging Tech Pell
intro:
Specimen 4-B. Specimen 4-C.
Names make it harder. So: none.
battle_won:
Contact event, resolved.
I'll file you under 'visitor.'
battle_lost:
One of them licked my glove.
I logged it as 'contact event.'
after:
4-C has a name now. Moss.
Don't tell my supervisor.

fin_wlab_tech_8.name: Archive Tech Quill
intro:
The early stock didn't hold
shape. We keep them for study.
battle_won:
The shelf stays shut. Good.
Some study is best left asleep.
battle_lost:
Don't open the back shelf.
Please. Not for my sake. Theirs.
after:
Three of them faced the door.
Now I know what they wanted.

fin_wlab_tech_9.name: Growth Tech Sabine
intro:
Growth rate is the good news.
The research is the good news.
battle_won:
See? Growth wins out.
It always does in here.
battle_lost:
They grow fast because we
make them. I said it. Satisfied?
after:
I tore the schedule down.
No more feeding to a clock.

fin_wlab_tech_10.name: Dosing Tech Brannick
intro:
Hold still. This is routine.
Well. A procedure. Hold still.
battle_won:
Steady hands, steady dose.
Go home. Forget this floor.
battle_lost:
They flinch when I enter now.
Is that in the data? It should be.
after:
My hands won't stop shaking.
Good. They should.

fin_wlab_tech_11.name: Vat Tech Hollis
intro:
Vat 7 is my best yield yet.
You won't spoil my best batch.
battle_won:
My batch held. Of course it
held. Vat 7 never lets me down.
battle_lost:
The vat light went gold just now.
Like it knew. That's not possible.
after:
Vat 7's empty. It's the
best thing it's ever yielded.

fin_wlab_tech_12.name: Mixing Tech Aldo
intro:
Formula's mine. Ondravel's
spark, river water, and time.
battle_won:
Spark, water, time. Today
the formula wins. Go.
battle_lost:
Without the river they'd be
nothing. We took that too.
after:
Follow the drains, {player}.
They all run to the river.

fin_wlab_tech_13.name: Core Tech Renske
intro:
The crystal draws, we harvest.
It's science. It's just science.
battle_won:
The core keeps its draw.
He keeps his silence. For now.
battle_lost:
He's awake in there, {player}.
He's been awake the whole time.
after:
The helix is louder. He's
calling. Go and answer.

fin_wlab_tech_14.name: Core Tech Marlo
intro:
Helix at 140 percent and climbing.
Don't touch a single dial.
battle_won:
Load holds. Yield holds.
We all hold. That's the job.
battle_lost:
Overdriven. Like me. Fine.
The dials are yours.
after:
Hear that note? Same as his crest.
The lab only ever sang his song.

fin_wlab_tech_15.name: Observer Tamsin
intro:
Every window shows the river.
They made sure we'd see it.
battle_won:
Back down you go. The glass
stays clean. The notes stay neat.
battle_lost:
Leave the doors open behind you.
That's all I ever wanted to say.
after:
Tonight they'll reach the river.
I'll watch. I owe them that.

fin_wlab_chief.name: Head of Research Corwen
intro:
Twelve years of research,
{player}. Every line, my yield.

Line 1 gave us all of it.
I won't let you undo that.
battle_won:
Retention restored. The research
goes on. It always goes on.

Leave quietly. The lines are
sleeping, and so is the past.
battle_lost:
So the stock outlives the study.
Write that down. I can't.

Go to him. Tell Ondravel...
No. He already knows.
after:
We called it creation. He called
it something else, I'm sure.

Open the dome. I'll stand here
and watch the numbers fall.

frostspire_climber_fix.old:
My hands are too cold to tie
a single knot. Not one.
frostspire_climber_fix.new:
My fingers are frozen stiff.
I can't even tie a knot.
frostspire_climber_fix.note: In every copy the knot line is page 1 of start, not page 2. Rewritten so page 2 ('Anything warm? Tea, maybe?...') follows on naturally.

pages:
Short on wins? Two helpers wait
on the high ledge above the ice.

Ride the middle lane, by the
pillar. The wind takes you up.
